name: Microgrid PV ramp-rate coordination
summary: Constrains the assigned PV target changes according to the selected microgrid operating limits.
description: Constrains the assigned PV target changes according to the selected microgrid operating limits. Renewable-generation coordination connects variable resource availability, inverter operating limits and the microgrid power target. Available solar or wind power, an issued curtailment request and actual delivered power are different signals.

In a microgrid with solar generation, the controller can restrain inverter output when local load and storage cannot absorb the available power. The resource controller reports its own availability and accepted operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “PV target and ramp limits” at the input and “Rate-limited PV target” at the output. Natural resource changes can reduce actual output faster.
